Package ca.mcgill.ecse321.gameorganizer.dto

Class LendingRecordResponseDto

java.lang.Object
ca.mcgill.ecse321.gameorganizer.dto.LendingRecordResponseDto
public class LendingRecordResponseDto extends Object
Comprehensive DTO for lending record responses that includes detailed information about the associated borrow request, game, and users. Used for presenting detailed lending history information to clients.

    • LendingRecordResponseDto

      public LendingRecordResponseDto(int id, Date startDate, Date endDate, String status, LendingRecordResponseDto.GameInfo game, LendingRecordResponseDto.UserInfo borrower, LendingRecordResponseDto.UserInfo owner, long durationInDays, boolean isDamaged, String damageNotes, int damageSeverity, Date damageAssessmentDate)
      Constructs a new LendingRecordResponseDto with the specified properties including damage information.
      Parameters:
      id - The unique identifier of the lending record
      startDate - The start date of the lending period
      endDate - The end date of the lending period
      status - The current status of the lending record
      game - The game information
      borrower - The borrower information
      owner - The owner information
      durationInDays - The duration of the lending in days
      isDamaged - Flag indicating if the game was returned damaged
      damageNotes - Notes describing any damage
      damageSeverity - The severity of the damage (0-3)
      damageAssessmentDate - The date when damage was assessed
